a.lede: SpaceX has completed a wet dress rehearsal for Starship, in preparation for its first orbital test flight.
a.title: SpaceX Starship's first orbital flight test on track after successful launch rehearsal

b.lede: Starship had already flown 99 percent of the way to low-Earth orbit. Monday's flight added the last bit.
b.title: SpaceX's Starship goes orbital, deploying first next-gen Starlinks
